name: DeployProgressDialog
title: Templates/Platform/Create/DeployProgressDialog
summary: The modal progress of one deploy that activates several Deployment Settings, each on its own, and the drop-to-deploy confirm that starts it. The `Dialog` is titled Deploying 2 of 5… while it runs, cannot be dismissed and keeps Close disabled; under the title the tally says how many succeeded and failed and that the ones that succeeded stay live. A `Progress` bar and Activating <name> track the run, a `ToggleGroup` filters All, Deploying, Failed and Done with their counts, and each row names the settings and the environments and projects it reaches, with a `Spinner` and a status `Tag` while it deploys and an `OutcomeMark` once it settles. When the run settles the header gains a large `OutcomeMark` and the outcome reports through one toast with Edit and Redeploy, as every async action does; a failed row says why and the footer offers Retry failed. The toast stays the standard for deploys: this dialog is only for the drop-to-deploy and multi-settings path. Built from `Dialog`, `PanelHeader`, `PanelContent`, `PanelFooter`, `Progress`, `ToggleGroup`, `Spinner`, `Tag`, `OutcomeMark`, `Button` and `Toaster`. The page behind it is a page body for ConsoleLayout.

variants.name: Drop
variants.summary: The drop-to-deploy confirm: New production deployment, the service with a Production `Tag`, what the files replace, and the dropped folder with its file count, total size and a scrollable list of paths with sizes formatted by `Intl.NumberFormat`. Cancel closes; Deploy to Production opens the progress dialog and starts the run.

variants.name: PartialFailure
variants.summary: Settled with one failure: Deployed 4 of 5 Deployment Settings with a warning `OutcomeMark`, staging-settings marked Failed with the reason, Retry failed beside Close, and an error toast with Edit (reopens the dialog on the failed rows) and Redeploy.

variants.name: Succeeded
variants.summary: Every Deployment Setting deployed: a large animated success `OutcomeMark` beside Deployed 5 Deployment Settings, every row Done, Close enabled, and a success toast with Edit and Redeploy.
